annotationRationale: Uniform interval lengths give the two half-probabilities. Conditioning on the half chosen and combining the corresponding success probabilities uses the law of total probability.
sourceMethod: Follows the first official method, splitting Laurent's interval into equal halves and using symmetry on the lower half. Makes the zero probability of a tie explicit.

review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithfully rephrases the first approach in MAA Solution 15 on page 5. The added conditional-uniformity and tie explanations make the official interval-splitting argument self-contained.
